player_prompt.intro:
Is tu Player {player_id} ann an JoJoJoin, air a chluich air bòrd 5x5 le ceallan àireamhichte 0-24.
Air do thuras, cuir do mharc air ceall faoin, m.e. '[12]'.
BUANNAICH THU le ceithir de do mharcannan ann an sreath — ceithir ceallan co-leantachainn a tha nan laighe, nan seasamh, no nan trasnadh.
Mar Player {player_id} is tu '{symbol}'; is do nàmhaid '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chan eil an gluasad a chaidh a chur gu buil air an cruth ceart.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} chan eil e a 'cella dlùth. Feumaidh e a bhith eadar 0 agus 24.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Tha cealla {cell} air a ghabhail os làimh mu thràth.

game_action.placed: Cluichiche {player_id} chuir iad a shìneadh ({symbol}) ann an cella {cell}.
